subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI should show compact run progress for long or multi-agent tasks

question: What canonical activity/progress contract should the Control UI consume for active chat runs, subagent waits, tool waits, final delivery, and reconnect recovery?
rationale: This is not a narrow UI patch: the requested display depends on public gateway/session activity semantics, and current related PRs differ in scope while the canonical API issue is still open.

options.title: Approve gateway activity contract first
options.body: Define the sessions activity/attention RPC or event model, safe progress fields, reconnect resync behavior, and child-run rollup before merging a Control UI strip.

options.title: Allow a narrow UI-only interim
options.body: Permit Control UI to show only existing hasActiveRun and visible preamble/tool progress while leaving subagent, reconnect, and activity-state semantics to the broader API issue.

options.title: Defer the progress surface
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers are ready to own a public activity/progress contract and close or merge the open PR candidates.

recommendation.title: Approve gateway activity contract first
recommendation.body: Define the sessions activity/attention RPC or event model, safe progress fields, reconnect resync behavior, and child-run rollup before merging a Control UI strip.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to the canonical gateway activity issue that should settle the backend contract this UI needs.
